Cliff.description: The towering Cliff, a jagged sentinel of stone, looms overhead, its sheer face etched with ancient secrets and whispered tales of forgotten eras, adding an imposing 100 feet to any who dare approach its base.

Cave.description: The Cave, a labyrinthine network of ancient stone chambers carved into the heart of an unyielding mountain, whispers secrets of survival and stealth through its echoing silence. Each narrow passage and shadowed alcove harbors tales of those who dared to tread this silent sanctuary, their presence felt only in the way the air seems to thicken with hidden dangers and untold mysteries.
